ch-hero.text: No hope-first rule. The honest count leads, the projection sits right under it, and the top now shows what other studies found. This is no longer a choice for you. You can still check each top number with its Note button.

ch-offreader.text: You're right, you never said that. The cards stay on every page, each tagged "Checked as hooked" or "Not checked for addiction". Cards that matter mainly for men who are truly hooked (withdrawal, medicine) say so.

ch-sections.text: That question was unclear, so it's gone. Each section came in two looks; I picked one per section. You can still switch any section with the bar above it, but you don't have to.

general.text: The 1280 frame only previews a laptop screen. The real page fills your browser window, up to 1720 px wide, and stays centred on a bigger monitor.

sec-beliefs.text: Belief 1 now uses a different study (a 1992 US survey) instead of the number at the top. I checked every belief on all four pages for repeats and replaced them. The reframe wording stays.

"Test it this week" is gone. Each belief now has "When this thought comes": one small thing to do when the thought shows up on its own, never seeking out the hard part. The old tests are kept in the background.

sec-hero.text: Notes now open right at the thing you're noting. "Half are free about 14 years after getting hooked" is back at the top. The hedge words are gone; the top now says what "hooked" meant and what other studies found (alcohol: 60 in 100 across 26 surveys, 67 in 100 in New Zealand). Your note was typed but not saved; I read it anyway, and unsaved notes now say so.

sec-graph.text: The 0–10 score is gone. The graph now has one line per thing posts mention at each stage (cravings, anxiety, low mood and more, plus better mood and feeling proud): how many posts in 100 mention it. The comments stay.
